clips.title: 彭博科技主播：苹果诉OpenAI窃密，硅谷硬件人才战升级

subtitles.en: Well, I mean, this is a big story and I would say probably actually as much about Silicon Valley's look to the future of hardware as it is the people, you know, if you think
subtitles.zh: 这确实是个大新闻，我认为这既关乎人才，也关乎硅谷对硬件未来的布局。

subtitles.en: about the landscape of Apple and Meta as examples trying to work out how people consumers use AI through different device form factors, the smartphone is what we mostly use but glasses are coming in, people have tried pins, that's kind of the underlying layer of the story which
subtitles.zh: 以苹果和Meta为例，它们都在探索消费者如何通过不同设备形态使用AI。智能手机仍是主流，但眼镜正在兴起，还有人尝试过别针设备，这是故事的底层逻辑。

subtitles.en: is interesting but in terms of Apple versus open AI the sort of full economic and litigating might of Apple against open AI, it's very serious.
subtitles.zh: 但就苹果对OpenAI而言，苹果动用全部经济和诉讼力量，这非常严重。

subtitles.en: You just referenced it but what does this mean for open AI when it comes to trying to expand into hardware and when it comes to actually making money from people using AI which is a bit of a...
subtitles.zh: 你刚提到，这对OpenAI进军硬件以及从AI使用中盈利意味着什么？

clips.speaker: Ed Ludlow
clips.title: 彭博科技主播：苹果指控OpenAI挖角400名员工，硬件合作变诉讼

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean in the suit, Apple describes open AI's hardware effort as nascent but you gave the key details which is that Apple claims are about 400 Apple alumni now working at open AI
subtitles.zh: 在诉讼中，苹果称OpenAI的硬件努力尚在初期，但关键细节是苹果声称约有400名前苹果员工现在在OpenAI工作。

subtitles.en: and the specifics which open AI executives coached those hires as the suit alleges on how to sort of leave Apple smoothly with as the suit alleges documents etc.
subtitles.zh: 诉讼还指控OpenAI高管指导这些员工如何顺利离职，并带走文件等。

subtitles.en: We don't know much about the form factor where open AI's at with its device progress but the back story is very much bigger than that, a couple of years ago the company started working together on software for the iPhone, integrating open AI's AI technology in Siri,
subtitles.zh: 我们不清楚OpenAI设备进展的具体形态，但背景故事远不止于此。几年前两家公司开始合作，为iPhone开发软件，将OpenAI的AI技术整合到Siri中。

subtitles.en: then Johnny Ive struck up a relationship with Apple and with open AI sorry and it's kind of soured from there, the net result we don't know.
subtitles.zh: 随后乔纳森·艾维与苹果和OpenAI都建立了关系，但关系从此承压，最终结果未知。
